beginner.introduction: Non-fiction is writing based on real people, events, and ideas.
beginner.coreExplanation: Forms include biography, autobiography, memoir, travelogue, and creative non-fiction.

university.introduction: Non-fiction prose encompasses factual narrative forms with literary style.
university.coreExplanation: Biography = life of another; Autobiography = life of self; Memoir = memory-focused; Travelogue = journeys; Creative non-fiction = literary style applied to fact.
university.comparativeAnalysis: Orwell’s *Shooting an Elephant* (memoir/personal essay) vs Sontag’s *Illness as Metaphor* (critical essay).

quickRevisionPoints: Types: biography, autobiography, memoir, travelogue, creative non-fiction

distinction.criticalAnalysis: Non-fiction performs cultural critique — blending fact with interpretation.
distinction.comparativeDistinctionAnalysis: Orwell’s personal narrative vs Sontag’s critical analysis vs Mill’s philosophical argument.
